thread:
maria: Hey team — customer on Dedicated EU cluster reporting repeated 503s for their inference route and high tail latency. They provided these request ids: req_8f3b2a, req_8f3b2b, req_8f3b2c. Can infra grab node/pod logs and GPU metrics?

samira: Thanks — can we get a quick curl repro from the customer? ask them to hit /v1/generate with their API key and include x-rw-request-id header. Example:  ```curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" -H "x-rw-request-id: req_8f3b2a" -d '{"model":"rw-instruct-small","input":"hi"}' https://eu.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate```

maria: sent that to customer, they replied with this failure snippet: ```HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
Date: Tue, 10 May 2026 14:12:03 GMT
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"backend timeout", "request_id":"req_8f3b2a"}```

oncall-bot: new incident created: INC-2026-348. Assigning to eng-oncall.
dinesh: I'm on it. Which dedicated pool is this?
maria: tenant reported it's on eu-dedicated-2, GPU nodes are p4d-like. Customer says the issue started after a config rollout yesterday at 03:00 UTC.
dinesh: OK grabbing pods for tenant-123. Running: ```kubectl -n tenant-123 get pods -o wide | grep generate``` — will paste logs.
kevin: Heads up — if a node OOM/cgroup kill happened you might see partial logs. Also check nvidia-smi and dmesg for GPU driver resets.
dinesh: Pod list shows 3 replicas: generate-5f9c8, generate-5f9c9, generate-5f9ca. Collecting logs: ```kubectl -n tenant-123 logs generate-5f9c9 -c runtime --since=2h > /tmp/req_8f3b2a.log```
dinesh: Found repeated KV cache miss warnings and a few "cuda:context lost" stack traces around 14:11:58, also this entry referencing request id: ```[14:11:58] request=req_8f3b2a latency=4123ms status=503 backend_error=timeout kernel=quantize_loop```
dinesh: On node eu-ded-02 I see GPU reset events: ```[  687.123456] NVRM: GPU at 0000:00:1e.0: GPU has fallen off the bus.```. Running `nvidia-smi -q` now.
kevin: Good find. Please grab kubelet logs for that node and export metrics: `kubectl logs -n kube-system kubelet-eu-ded-02` and `rdm node-metrics eu-ded-02 --output=json > /tmp/node-metrics.json` (rdm = redwood diagnostics tool).
samira: Customer also has a repro curl, they ran it in a loop and attached timestamps showing occasional 503s at 14:11–14:13 UTC. They gave us the full curl output and core dump? ask if they can upload a debug bundle to our support portal.
maria: Asked them to run our support collector on their side and provide the bundle id. Sent instructions: ```curl https://internal-support.redwood.ai/collect -F 'tenant=123' -F 'since=2h' -F 'request_ids=req_8f3b2a,req_8f3b2b' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <support-token>'```
dinesh: I've collected pod logs, kubelet, dmesg, nvidia-smi output, and node metrics. Packaging into /tmp/eu-ded-02-bundle.tar.gz. Uploading to support bucket now.
dinesh: Upload done: gs://redwood-support/eu-ded-02/1846001234-eu-ded-02-bundle.tar.gz
samira: Can you include the kube-snapshot and the relevant container runtime logs (containerd)? sometimes the GPU reset correlates with containerd restarts.
dinesh: Added containerd logs: `/var/log/containerd.log` and the runtime core dump. Also included environment: driver 525.85.12, CUDA 11.8, nvidia-device-plugin v0.10.0.
maria: Sending the bundle link to the customer and SRE. Also requested they attach any client-side logs and the exact curl command they used (they already provided the one above).
kevin: Next steps: SRE to correlate kernel GPU resets with the hardware telemetry (GPU ECC errors) and we'll replay the customer's curl against a staging replica pinned to the same model/kernels. If we can reproduce, open a hw support ticket with cloud vendor.
samira: Thanks all — marking as actionable. Please add the bundle link to INC-2026-348 and note which request ids are in the bundle.
maria: Done. INC updated with gs://redwood-support/eu-ded-02/1846001234-eu-ded-02-bundle.tar.gz and request_ids=[req_8f3b2a,req_8f3b2b,req_8f3b2c]. I'll follow up with the customer tomorrow after SRE digs in. :thumbsup:
